SELECT @@TRANCOUNT AS transaction_count, XACT_STATE() AS transaction_state,
  @@DATEFIRST AS datefirst, CASE WHEN (@@OPTIONS & 512) = 512 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nocount,
  CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#reset_probe') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS temp_exists
SET DATEFIRST 3; SET NOCOUNT ON; CREATE TABLE #reset_probe (n INT); INSERT #reset_probe VALUES (7)
